C6-C10 all crash before writing (is_sea has an extra length-1 time axis), so the saved mask comes from C5. C5 uses a leap-unaware day of year for non-leap years, which makes target 2003 use smoothed doys 152-243. These depend on raw thresholds for doys 137-258, whose pools are 11-day windows spanning May 11/12 to Sep 19/20 of each baseline year. Every target day and every region cell feeds the per-cell comparison and run logic."}
